necessity_rules.necessary: the commander; or removing it breaks a win condition, the deck's only engine member, a required package's minimum, or every Spellbook combo in the list
necessity_rules.important: removing it breaks at least one Spellbook combo, or it is identity core, a blueprint tutor target, or a win piece / enabler
necessity_rules.redundant: it belongs to a package or key role and at least one other card does the same job
necessity_rules.independent: none of the above (no package, combo, win or key-role membership; or the only card in its role outside any structure)

produces: Infinite draw triggers for all players

nodes.name: cecily-attack
nodes.online_condition: Cecily attacks; with 11+ cards in hand after the draw, cast an instant or sorcery free.

nodes.name: hand-size
nodes.online_condition: Draw engines running to reach eleven.

flag_kind.note: With an odd number of cards in library, Peer + Teferi's Ageless Insight makes you draw from an empty library and lose before any drain or damage trigger resolves. Count the library first (a cantrip or one fetch changes parity), or win through Psychosis Crawler/Niv-Mizzet only when the parity is safe.
Notion Thief and the Breach + Wheel + Jeska's Will loop conflict: Thief steals the opponents' wheel draws, leaving Jeska's Will's mana mode at zero. Use one plan or the other in a given turn.

The source blueprint's commander summaries don't match current Oracle text (Bjorna has no noncreature-spell trigger; Cecily triggers on attack, not combat damage). It's documentation only; the approved list and the retrospective rules attestation use the correct text.
